introHtml: Rectangular shapes offer a clean, modern canvas for your message, making them ideal for safety labels, promotional stickers, or branded patches that need to stand out without the bulk of round buttons. Unlike circular designs, rectangular formats give you more space for logos, text, and QR codes, and they fit neatly on lanyards, hard hats, or product packaging. Whether you need durable vinyl stickers for equipment or sew-on patches for uniforms, the rectangular shape ensures your branding stays sharp and legible.
